_comment: Resolution check for the stationary survey (31 Oct 2026): the large sweep's box at 10 half-periods along the line instead of 18, same 512 points, so dx = 10 L / 512 = 0.020 L instead of 9 L / 256 = 0.035 L (points per stripe wavelength 1.8 times the sweep's: 45 instead of 25 at mu 0.90, 20 instead of 11 at 0.98). n_periods must be even: it counts half periods pi / k1 of the pattern along x, and an odd count makes the initial condition antiperiodic across the box edge (a sign seam). Same h, tmax, nsave, Rscale, amp and centering as 1024_large_mu_sweep. The crop keeps the full 10 L along the line (the survey's window is the inner 80 percent, here 8 L) and 384 rows = 7.5 L across it. Ny_factor 5 gives Ly = 50 L. Angles: the knee-to-intermediate stretch and the spike, 0.72 to 0.84, plus four dislocation angles. Run: python run_sh_pgb_zigzag.py --config res_check_np10_1031.json
